title: Add shadcn components, renderers, TypeScript types, and comprehensive fumadocs documentation
body:
Completes shadcn UI component coverage by adding missing components, creating renderers for all documented components, adding complete TypeScript type definitions, and providing JSON schema-driven documentation organized in collapsible category navigation. ## Components Added - **toast**: Radix-UI toast primitives with `useToast` hook and `Toaster` renderer - **date-picker**: Calendar popup integration with date-fns formatting - **combobox**: Searchable dropdown with Command palette integration ```tsx // JSON schema approach { type: 'date-picker', placeholder: 'Pick a date', onDateChange: 'handleDateChange' } // Direct usage import { DatePicker } from '@object-ui/components'; ``` ## Component Renderers Created (14 total) Created renderer implementations for all documented components to eliminate "unknown type" errors: - **Form components**: combobox, command - **Feedback components**: toast, spinner, empty, sonner - **Data display**: breadcrumb, kbd - **Disclosure**: toggle-group - **Basic**: button-group, pagination, navigation-menu - **Layout**: aspect-ratio - **Overlay**: menubar Each renderer follows the ObjectUI pattern: - Registers with `ComponentRegistry` - Accepts schema props for JSON-driven rendering - Handles designer metadata (data-obj-id, data-obj-type) - Provides default props and input definitions ## TypeScript Type Definitions Added complete schema type definitions in `@object-ui/types` package for all new components: - **ComboboxSchema** - Searchable select component - **CommandSchema** - Command palette component - **SpinnerSchema** - Loading spinner - **EmptySchema** - Empty state display - **SonnerSchema** - Sonner toast integration - **BreadcrumbSchema** - Navigation breadcrumbs - **KbdSchema** - Keyboard key display - **ToggleGroupSchema** - Toggle button group (using `selectionType` property) - **ButtonGroupSchema** - Button group - **NavigationMenuSchema** - Navigation menu - **AspectRatioSchema** - Aspect ratio container - **MenubarSchema** - Menu bar component All types are properly exported and integrated into the union types for each category. ## Documentation Comprehensive fumadocs MDX documentation for 30 components across all categories: - **Form**: combobox, command, date-picker, radio-group, label, input-otp, form - **Overlay**: alert-dialog, sheet, hover-card, context-menu, dropdown-menu, menubar - **Data Display**: breadcrumb, calendar, carousel, timeline, kbd - **Layout**: scroll-area, resizable, aspect-ratio - **Feedback**: toast, sonner, spinner, empty - **Disclosure**: toggle, toggle-group - **Basic**: button-group, pagination, navigation-menu, sidebar Each doc includes: - Interactive `ComponentDemo` examples - Complete TypeScript schema definitions - JSON property configuration patterns - Variant demonstrations ## Documentation Organization - Collapsible Categories Restructured fumadocs navigation to display components in **expandable/collapsible category folders** in the sidebar: - **Basic** (9 components): text, icon, image, separator, html, sidebar, button-group, pagination, navigation-menu - **Form** (14 components): button, input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio-group, switch, slider, label, date-picker, input-otp, combobox, command, form - **Layout** (9 components): container, card, grid, flex, stack, tabs, scroll-area, resizable, aspect-ratio - **Data Display** (9 components): badge, avatar, alert, list, calendar, carousel, timeline, breadcrumb, kbd - **Feedback** (7 components): loading, progress, skeleton, spinner, empty, toast, sonner - **Overlay** (10 components): dialog, drawer, tooltip, popover, alert-dialog, sheet, hover-card, context-menu, dropdown-menu, menubar - **Disclosure** (4 components): accordion, collapsible, toggle, toggle-group - **Complex** (1 component): table ### Implementation Details - Updated `docs/components/meta.json` to reference folder names directly for collapsible folder support - Updated subdirectory `meta.json` files for each category with complete component lists - Fumadocs automatically creates collapsible folders based on directory structure - Each category can be expanded/collapsed independently for better navigation Users can now browse all components organized by expandable category folders in the documentation sidebar. ## Exports - Renamed `Toaster` from toast system to `ToastNotifier` to avoid conflict with Sonner's `Toaster` - Exported `useToast` hook from main index - Set toast auto-dismiss to 5s (was 16m) ## Build & Test Results - ✅ All packages build successfully - ✅ Documentation site builds with **123 static pages** (up from 109) - ✅ All **205 tests** passing - ✅ No TypeScript compilation errors - ✅ All component documentation pages render correctly with interactive demos - ✅ No "unknown type" errors - every documented component has a working renderer
Original prompt > components/ui 对齐 https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components 所有的基础组件，可提供基于json的属性配置，并提供完善的fumadocs 文档
